svg.title: WaitWell information architecture
svg.desc: SMS link opens Status home. A vertical spine branches to journey steps with waiting, in progress and completed states, a delay notice under tests, then Care team, Share, and Info with Facilities and Help pages. SMS updates reopen the current step screen.
svg.text: Sent when a step starts, a delay happens
or your turn is close. Opens the screen it is about.

g.text: Names and roles of the clinicians caring for you
